fullContent:
Praval Panchamrit Ras – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Introduction 
 Praval Panchamrit Ras is an herbal formulation in the form of tablet or powder. It has calming effect also aids in curing bloating, anorexia, ascites, splenic disorders, cough, asthma, anorexia, indigestion, burping, malabsorption syndrome, diarrhea, antral gastritis, urinary tract disorders, urine retention, calculi and etc. Helpful and beneficial in balancing Vata and Kapha disorders. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Pearl Bhasma (Mukta bhasma) 
 Conch shell Bhasma (Shankha bhasma) 
 Pearl oyster bhasma (Shukti bhasma) 
 Coral bhasma (Pravala bhasma) 
 Calotropis procera (Latex of arka) 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 All the ingredients are pounded in khalva yantra to obtain fine powder, then arka is added and triturated to form paste like consistency, rolled into circles. It is then dried in sunlight and kept in shrav samputa heated at a high temperature. The final product is then collected and made into pills of 125 mg each. 
 Dosage 
 250 mg twice daily with honey, ghee and milk before or after meal as directed by Ayurvedic doctors. 
 Indications 
 
 Bloating 
 Ascites 
 Cough 
 Asthma 
 Anorexia 
 Indigestion 
 Malabsorption syndrome 
 Diarrhea 
 Urinary tract disorders 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Self-medication is not advised. 
 Over dosage can have severe side effects. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
